why: The sandbox boundary (design/sandbox-boundary.md). statusOf calls fetch: an outside call, the same fake on both sides, destructured in the candidate: PASS-bounded, and under LEAN_NET=deny it opens no socket (the record names the mode and no denied attempt). reachNet and reachFetch leave the vm context through a host intrinsic and attempt a real connection (net.connect, the worker's own fetch); under LEAN_NET=deny each attempt fails with ERR_ACCESS_DENIED before a socket exists, on both sides alike (PASS-bounded), and the record names the attempt. They are not lane B rows in the open mode: there the answer is the machine's (ECONNREFUSED or a listener), not the unit's.
